authority: Operator decision returned in plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md item 5, folded into Tier 3 by plans/fieldwise_tickets.md ticket 6. Recorded per CLAUDE.md §9.4; status per §12.2.
decision: Ten KPIs K1-K10 are accepted as drafted, each tied to one deliverable that exists in the work-package seed. All six Tier 2B expected impacts are mapped: EI-01, EI-02 and EI-05 to draft content, and EI-03, EI-04 and EI-06 to measures the operator decided because the draft addresses none of them.
why: The draft declines advance numeric targets for water saving and commits to quantifying impact from project evidence (§2.3 ¶243). Every accepted KPI measures something the project controls and delivers, so the KPI set respects that refusal rather than overriding it. phase_05_gate predicate g06_p04 requires every expected impact to carry a mapped project output, and the draft covered only three of six.

contradictions_resolved.what: The EI-04 candidate asserted that ELTE's HR Excellence in Research status would be stated in §3.2, while the answer line beside it said the status was unknown.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: The operator confirmed on 2026-08-11 that ELTE does NOT hold the award. The claim is removed permanently, not provisionally, and must not be restored unless ELTE actually obtains it. EI-04 now rests on the Career Development Plan (D1.3), ELTE's open recruitment and researcher-development policies, and the §1.3 supervision arrangements.
contradictions_resolved.residual: EI-04 is the thinnest of the six mappings, with no external accreditation behind it. g06_p04 still passes, because the predicate requires a mapped output and D1.3 is one.

contradictions_resolved.what: Items 5 and 6 treated teaching as a competence the fellowship would build, while the CV shows five years of university teaching at Agricultural University Plovdiv, 2015-2020.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: The operator raised the ambition. EI-06 becomes co-design and delivery of a full module unit in an ELTE MSc course, primary supervision of one MSc thesis to completion, and co-supervision of one PhD student's field-experiment component. The Career Development Plan's teaching component is reframed as an existing strength transferred to a new discipline, institution and language of instruction.
contradictions_resolved.residual: Two consequences, neither a gate matter. The workload sits in a 3.0 person-month cross-cutting allocation and may need to be stated as part of the training allocation. Primary supervision of an ELTE MSc thesis may require a formal ELTE status the fellow will not automatically hold; if it does, the measure drops to co-supervision and the module unit carries the ambition.

not_folded.K11: Item 5 raised a K11 for the Career Development Plan, because D1.3 is the one deliverable with no KPI. The operator's answer line accepts K1-K10 and its edits block is empty, so K11 was raised and not decided. It is recorded in impacts.json as Unresolved with the candidate wording, not folded as accepted (§13.3). It blocks nothing: g06_p05 checks that each KPI names a deliverable, not that each deliverable carries a KPI.

no_deliverable_for_two_measures: The EI-03 and EI-06 measures are activities, and no deliverable in workpackage_seed.json covers them. Their mapped_project_outputs arrays are empty with the reason stated, rather than pointing at an invented deliverable id. Phase 3 owns the deliverable list and Phase 5 may propose additions.
gate_effect: phase_05_gate g06_p04 and g06_p05 can both resolve from the Phase 5 output built on these records.
